headline: Gerdau Closes Steel Production at Divinópolis Unit
summary: Gerdau is shutting down steel production at its Divinópolis facility in Minas Gerais, Brazil, citing a lack of competitive iron ore supply and rising production costs.
why: Gerdau is a major global steel producer; operational closures reflect broader cost pressures and supply chain challenges within the industrial metals sector.

impacts.name: Gerdau
impacts.why: Operational closures indicate cost-cutting measures and potential margin pressure for the company.
